% figure (2026-11-23): the two diagrams of Compton scattering at order e^2, time upward, after PHY 513 Lecture 22 slides 5-6 and PS p. 158; generated by qft-C/tools/l22/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % ---------- diagram (a): absorb k, then emit k'
  \begin{scope}
    \coordinate (a) at (0,-0.8); \coordinate (b) at (0,0.8);
    \draw[fline] (0,-2.3)--(a); \draw[fline] (a)--(b); \draw[fline] (b)--(0,2.3);
    \draw[pline] (-1.7,-2.0)--(a); \draw[pline] (b)--(1.7,2.0);
    \node[fdv] at (a) {}; \node[fdv] at (b) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.35,-1.42)--(-0.75,-1.0); \node[fdlab, above left=-2pt] at (-1.05,-1.2) {$k$};
    \draw[fdmom] (0.75,1.0)--(1.35,1.42); \node[fdlab, below right=-2pt] at (1.05,1.2) {$k'$};
    \draw[fdmom] (0.22,-1.95)--(0.22,-1.35); \draw[fdmom] (0.22,1.35)--(0.22,1.95); \draw[fdmom] (0.22,-0.3)--(0.22,0.3);
    \node[fdlab, right] at (0.25,0) {$p + k$};
    \node[fdlab, below] at (0,-2.3) {$e^-\ (p)$,\ \ $u(p)$}; \node[fdlab, above] at (0,2.3) {$e^-\ (p')$,\ \ $\bar u(p')$};
    \node[fdlab, left] at (-1.7,-2.0) {$\gamma\ (k)$,\ $\epsilon_\nu(k)$}; \node[fdlab, right] at (1.7,2.0) {$\gamma\ (k')$,\ $\epsilon^*_\mu(k')$};
    \node[fdlab, right] at (0.05,-0.95) {$\nu$}; \node[fdlab, left] at (-0.05,0.95) {$\mu$};
    \node[font=\footnotesize] at (0,-3.25) {(a) $s$-channel: $(p + k)^2 = s$};
  \end{scope}
  \node at (3.3,0) {\large $+$};
  % ---------- diagram (b): emit k' first, absorb k later
  \begin{scope}[xshift=6.6cm]
    \coordinate (a) at (0,-1.0); \coordinate (b) at (0,1.0);
    \draw[fline] (0,-2.3)--(a); \draw[fline] (a)--(b); \draw[fline] (b)--(0,2.3);
    \draw[pline] (-1.9,-1.2)--(b); \draw[pline] (a)--(1.9,1.2);
    \node[fdv] at (a) {}; \node[fdv] at (b) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.62,-0.52)--(-1.1,0.08); \node[fdlab, above left=-2pt] at (-1.36,-0.2) {$k$};
    \draw[fdmom] (1.1,-0.08)--(1.62,0.52); \node[fdlab, below right=-2pt] at (1.36,0.2) {$k'$};
    \draw[fdmom] (0.22,-2.05)--(0.22,-1.45); \draw[fdmom] (0.22,1.45)--(0.22,2.05); \draw[fdmom] (0.22,0.15)--(0.22,0.75);
    \node[fdlab, right] at (0.25,0.45) {$p - k'$};
    \node[fdlab, below] at (0,-2.3) {$e^-\ (p)$,\ \ $u(p)$}; \node[fdlab, above] at (0,2.3) {$e^-\ (p')$,\ \ $\bar u(p')$};
    \node[fdlab, left] at (-1.9,-1.2) {$\gamma\ (k)$,\ $\epsilon_\nu(k)$}; \node[fdlab, right] at (1.9,1.2) {$\gamma\ (k')$,\ $\epsilon^*_\mu(k')$};
    \node[fdlab, left] at (-0.05,-1.15) {$\mu$}; \node[fdlab, right] at (0.05,1.15) {$\nu$};
    \node[font=\footnotesize] at (0,-3.25) {(b) $u$-channel: $(p - k')^2 = u$};
  \end{scope}
  \draw[->, gray] (10.6,-1.2)--(10.6,1.2); \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, right] at (10.6,0) {time};
\end{tikzpicture}
